info.name: 📌 Mistral AI API
info.description:
### About Mistral AI

"Frontier open-weight models you own and control."

Mistral AI builds its own open-weight Mistral models and serves them through its own API. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Model makers**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Mistral AI Account: [https://console.mistral.ai/](https://console.mistral.ai/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `mistral_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:mistral_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.mistral.ai/api](https://docs.mistral.ai/api)
    
- Models: [https://docs.mistral.ai/models](https://docs.mistral.ai/models)
